subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should `maxToolCallingRounds` ship as a built-in-OpenClaw-only config that fails before the model call on every selected plugin harness, or must harness selection/enforcement become capability-aware first?
rationale: The branch is technically coherent about failing closed, but this creates a permanent user config and agent-core contract whose behavior depends on provider/model harness routing; code inspection cannot choose that compatibility policy for maintainers.

options.title: Define capability-aware semantics
options.body: Keep the setting but require supported harness capability signaling and a documented rule for implicit fallback versus explicit unsupported harness selection before merge.

options.title: Accept built-in-only fail-closed
options.body: Approve the current contract where any selected plugin harness rejects the configured run before its model call, with the existing documentation treated as intentional operator behavior.

options.title: Pause the config surface
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and defer this PR until a cross-harness round-budget contract is ready.

recommendation.title: Define capability-aware semantics
recommendation.body: Keep the setting but require supported harness capability signaling and a documented rule for implicit fallback versus explicit unsupported harness selection before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal connects this person to existing tool-loop safeguards, agent-core loop behavior, and prior hard-budget API review.
